🔥Macros For One Sammy:

531 Calories
44g Protein
15g Fat
55g Carbs��The Best Muscle Building Chicken Sandwich (Makes 16 sandwiches):

✅ - 150g Chicken Thigh (Per sandwich. About 2400g total)

Bowl 1

✅ - 300g AP Flour (not all will stick, extra for room to work)

✅ - Salt & Pepper

✅ - Garlic Powder

✅ - Paprika

Bowl 2

✅ - 5 Large eggs (not all will stick, extra for room to work)

✅ - 100g Egg Whites (not all will stick, extra for room to work)

Bowl 3

✅ - 600g Crushed Cornflakes (not all will stick, extra for room to work)

Slaw:

✅ - 1 Tbsp Sesame Oil

✅ - 4 Tbsp Light Mayo

✅ - Kimchi

✅ - Minced Cabbage

Korean Glaze Sauce:

✅ - 2/3 Cup Low Cal Sweet Chili Sauce

✅ - 6 Tbsp Sriracha

✅ - 6 Tbsp Soy Sauce

✅ - 1/4 Cup Honey

Other:

✅ - Bread Of Choice (I used a sesame roll)

✅ - Pickles
